Metadata.title: Vocab – Learn English vocabulary
Metadata.description: Learn English vocabulary by topic and CEFR level, with flashcards, plain-English definitions and well-timed review reminders.

Home.title: Remember words for longer with spaced repetition
Home.subtitle: Flashcards with plain-English definitions, organised by topic and CEFR level. You get a reminder right before you would forget a word.
Home.status: In development – accounts and flashcards arrive in the next version.

srs.title: Flashcards & spaced repetition
srs.body: Rate each card Again / Hard / Good / Easy. The FSRS algorithm schedules the next review for every word.

english.title: Explained in English
english.body: Clear English definitions, IPA, example sentences, plus the Vietnamese meaning for reference.

topics.title: By topic & level
topics.body: 20+ everyday topics, and every word is tagged with a level from A1 to C2.

progress.title: Progress, streaks & study time
progress.body: Track how well you know each word, your daily streak and minutes studied each day.

reminders.title: Review reminders
reminders.body: Get an email or a phone notification when words are due for review.

notes.title: Notes
notes.body: Write memory tricks and your own sentences for each word, or keep a personal notebook.
